Mission Local reported that MEDA bought the derelict building at 18th and Mission for $6 million, with plans to add at least 40 affordable homes. The reported project would add six stories and renovate the existing structure while preserving its historic elements. The units were expected to be sold as below-market-rate condominiums to households earning 80–130% of area median income, with about half planned as two- or three-bedroom homes.

That story covers the 18th and Mission building; it doesn’t establish whether tenants at a different building will have to move.
